Players Committee card image of [[Qi'ra]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “When forfeited at same location as Han or Vos, may satisfy all remaining battle damage against you. If you just initiated a battle or Force drain at same battleground and you have completed a Kessel Run, opponent loses 1 Force. Immune to attrition < 3.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Qi%27ra.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Qi'ra.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
